draft.author: Lance Zierlein
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.99, the 134th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 18th of 37 at CB. He lasted until pick 160, well after his grade rank (134th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Cordrea Tankersley. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 4 passes defended in 2020, 20th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Philadelphia Eagles (practice squad). 20 career games and 6 starts over 3 completed seasons. His 2023 season (3 AV) was his best yet. Weak spots: passes defended 1 (20th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 cornerback who played: 30.6% season snap share against a median of 40.4%, below the norm.
